Chapter 4895: Dark Apparitions’ Drama Of The Year! Are You Teaching Me How To Do Things? I’m Not Indulging You! Life Stain! (2) Editor: Henyee Translations

But now, Gu Jiu had appeared again.

Despite this strange and special method, he seemed to have really returned to the world. Even his personality was the same as in the past. Everybody wondered if he could cultivate and if he still possessed the same talent.

If he had that talent...

They stared at Gu Jiu coldly. As long as the devil god didn’t interfere, they would let him return to death.

Maybe after today’s bet, the devil god wouldn’t need him anymore and would let him die on his own.

The devil titans felt emotional. Their gazes turned colder and there was killing intent in them.

However, they hid their killing intent well. It only lasted for a split second before it disappeared.

However...

"You want to kill me? Hahaha, you want to kill me! You actually want to kill me!"

Gu Jiu looked at the devil titans’ gazes and sensed something. Then, he started laughing like a maniac as if he got stimulated. He stared coldly at the devil titans.

You would never understand what a maniac was thinking.

Even though he was facing a bunch of devil titans, he still dared to fight with them.

This was much more powerful than the Blood God Clone, who admitted that he was inferior.

The devil titans were shocked. They didn’t think that they would still be discovered. They were even more puzzled. Wasn’t this what happened to Gu Jiu in the past?

Without the top talent, he wouldn’t be able to do this.

"Gu Jiu, the devil god didn’t ask you to go crazy here."

Devil Titan Gu Kui’s eyes lit up. He didn’t dare to think too much and didn’t dare to let Gu Jiu continue speaking. He interrupted him coldly.

"Are you teaching me how to do things?" Gu Jiu stared coldly at Devil Titan Gu Kui.

"I’m just reminding you on behalf of the devil god." Devil Titan Gu Kui didn’t reply to him. He bowed slightly at the devil god.

At the mention of the devil god, Gu Jiu finally regained some of his composure. He didn’t dare to make a fuss anymore and bowed at the devil god. "Thank you for giving me a new lease of life. I’m extremely grateful. Praise our god!"

I didn’t expect this fellow to be so mushy too. He even praised his god. The Blood God Clone thought to himself in disdain.

Wait, why did he say ’too’?

What did this have to do with him?

The next moment, he hurriedly shook his head and threw away the ridiculous thought that had just appeared in his mind. How could this Spiritual Bone Race guy be compared to him?

He was pleasing the devil god because he wanted to help the vampire race escape from punishment and push the blame to the Spiritual Bone Race. He had no respect for this dark apparition devil god.

He was putting on a show!

Everyone could tell that this Gu Jiu was afraid of the devil god and respected him greatly.

No matter what, this was a devil god from the Spiritual Bone Race. As a dark apparition of the Spiritual Bone Race, no one would dare to disrespect this devil god.

Thus, there was a difference between the Blood God Clone and Gu Jiu. This had to be distinguished.

There was no point in comparing.

However, Devil Titan Shi Xue, Devil Titan Gu Kui, and the rest didn’t think of this. To them, the current Gu Jiu was similar to the Blood God Clone.

Some aspects overlapped.

They were both the top talents of their race. They looked down on everyone and suppressed many talents until they couldn’t raise their heads.

They were equally tough. They weren’t afraid even when facing someone much stronger than themselves.

They were both evil and could make people die of anger.

Also, they were equally shameless. They tried their best to please the devil god whom they couldn’t resist. Even other people couldn’t stand it and felt awkward for them. However, they didn’t care.

These were all too similar.

A strange thought appeared in the devil titans’ mind.

Were all top talents like them like this?

"Stop wasting time. If you defeat the vampire Blood Son, I can bring you back to life," Devil God Gu Guo said calmly.

Actually, this Gu Jiu was his real trump card.

Gu Jie was just a medium.

A medium that could allow Gu Jiu to appear again and temporarily possess the ability of the peak of the devil emperor stage.

From the start, he didn’t have much hope for Gu Jie. Of course, it would be great if Gu Jie could win, but if Gu Jie couldn’t, he needed to use his last trump card.

Devil God Gu Guo was confident in his ability. After all, he was one of the top talents of the Spiritual Bone Race. He would be able to stand out even after countless years.

From his point of view, the vampire Blood Son was a talent on the same level as Gu Jiu. Hence, only Gu Jiu could defeat him.

What’s more, Gu Jiu had a huge advantage because he had once stepped into the devil titan level, even if it was just at the beginning.

But this was his advantage.

No matter what, the foundation of a talent who went further was much stronger than a mid-tier devil emperor.

"Yes!" A hint of enthusiasm appeared in Gu Jiu’s eyes as he replied loudly.

Devil Titan Shi Xue, Devil Titan Gu Kui, and the other devil titans heaved a sigh of relief when they heard this. From the devil god’s words, they could tell that this skeleton wasn’t completely revived.

"He’s not completely revived." The Blood God Clone was surprised.

He didn’t understand.

He activated his Real Eye, but he still couldn’t see the other party’s condition.

Both his soul and his strength were enveloped by a thick ball of Dark Force.

This ball of Dark Force was too pure so he couldn’t see through it.

However, he still felt two different spiritual auras merging into Gu Jie’s body in a strange and subtle way.

It was strange because he could sense two spiritual auras intertwining and tearing each other. They were mutating.

Even if he couldn’t see the mutation clearly, he could feel it.

In his eyes, there seemed to be two balls of shadows intertwining in a strange way.

At this moment, Gu Jiu looked over too. He seemed to have just discovered the Blood God Clone’s existence and didn’t take him seriously at all.

This was the truth. He didn’t notice the Blood God Clone at all.

This was a natural disregard.

Their gazes collided in mid-air.

One was cold, mocking, and even crazy.

The other was calm and composed.

The former belonged to Gu Jiu while the latter belonged to the Blood God Clone.

Gu Jiu was a little surprised by the Blood God Clone’s reaction. He hadn’t seen such a talent in a long time. He actually felt a sense of familiarity from this guy.

Hence, he got excited for no reason. He couldn’t help but laugh like a maniac.

"Hahaha..."

"Can you stop laughing? Your laughter is disgusting." The Blood God Clone didn’t pamper him. He dug his ears and interrupted his laughter.

He chose to sit at the side and watch the show when this Gu Jiu was arguing with the devil titans. He didn’t care how the guy laughed. It had nothing to do with him.

But the other party was still smiling at him. He couldn’t bear with it.

Did this guy think that he was the same as the devil titans?

That’s thinking too much.

He was extremely familiar with dealing with these crazy dark apparitions. He could send them away easily.

Silence.

Gu Jiu’s laughter stopped abruptly. He felt that his casting was interrupted.

The other party’s tone was calm. He felt as if he had punched a ball of cotton. It was light and there was nowhere to exert its strength.

Devil Titan Shi Xue, Devil Titan Gu Kui, and the other devil titans suddenly felt refreshed. They felt refreshed.

They couldn’t do anything to the other party but someone helped them vent their anger.

As expected, only a vampire like the Blood Son would be able to deal with this fellow.

It was obvious that they treated the Blood God Clone and Gu Jiu as the same kind of people. The feeling of deja vu was extremely strong.

"At first, I wanted to play with you. After all, I haven’t exercised for a long time. But now, it looks like you’re in a hurry to die." Gu Jiu sneered.

"Really?" The Blood God Clone gave him an ambiguous smile and said casually, "You seem very confident. I wonder how you died?"

Gu Jiu choked on his words.

Why are you bringing up the past when I’m talking about the present?

The jump was too great.

Can we have a proper conversation?

He had to admit that the Blood God Clone’s words hit the nail on the head. He recalled the painful past.

He defeated all his opponents in his life and looked down on everyone. In the end, he suffered a setback in the Light Universe. This was a stain in his life.

Now, the Blood God Clone brought it forward again. He couldn’t control the anger in his heart. His gaze turned sharp.
